title.en: The night the lights went out

en: Click! Suddenly the whole house went dark. Even the fan stopped turning.
Sari held Mama's hand. 'I can't see anything!' Mama said softly, 'Let's wait a moment. Our eyes will get used to the dark.'
Slowly Sari began to see shapes: the table, the window, Mama's smile.
Papa found the torch in the drawer where it always lives. Click! A circle of light shone on the floor.
With no TV and no fan, the house was quiet. Sari could hear crickets and frogs outside.
They sat together on the step and sang songs. Then, click! The lights came back on. Sari was almost sorry.
id: Klik! Tiba-tiba seluruh rumah gelap. Kipas angin pun berhenti berputar.
Sari memegang tangan Mama. 'Aku tidak bisa melihat apa-apa!' Mama berkata pelan, 'Kita tunggu sebentar. Mata kita akan terbiasa dengan gelap.'
Pelan-pelan Sari mulai melihat bentuk-bentuk: meja, jendela, senyum Mama.
Papa menemukan senter di laci, tempat senter selalu disimpan. Klik! Lingkaran cahaya menyinari lantai.
Tanpa TV dan kipas angin, rumah jadi sunyi. Sari bisa mendengar jangkrik dan katak di luar.
Mereka duduk bersama di tangga dan bernyanyi. Lalu, klik! Lampu menyala lagi. Sari malah sedikit kecewa.

objectives.en: Reads a story and explains how the main character's feelings change.
objectives.id: Membaca cerita dan menjelaskan bagaimana perasaan tokoh utama berubah.

objectives.en: Knows that our eyes slowly adjust to the dark and that a torch is safer than a candle.
objectives.id: Tahu bahwa mata pelan-pelan menyesuaikan diri dengan gelap dan senter lebih aman daripada lilin.

meaning.en: a small lamp you hold in your hand
slowly become comfortable with something new
meaning.id: pelan-pelan menjadi biasa dengan hal baru

meaning.en: an insect that chirps at night
meaning.id: serangga yang berbunyi di malam hari

prompt.en: Where did Papa find the torch?

en: in the drawer where it is always kept
id: di laci tempat senter selalu disimpan

prompt.en: What happened to Sari's eyes in the dark?
prompt.id: Apa yang terjadi pada mata Sari dalam gelap?

en: they slowly got used to the dark and saw shapes
they could see in total darkness straight away
they stopped working until the lights came back
id: pelan-pelan terbiasa dengan gelap dan melihat bentuk
langsung bisa melihat dalam gelap gulita

prompt.en: What did the family do after Papa found the torch?
prompt.id: Apa yang dilakukan keluarga itu setelah Papa menemukan senter?

en: they sat on the step and sang songs
id: mereka duduk di tangga dan bernyanyi

prompt.en: Why was Sari almost sorry when the lights came back?
prompt.id: Mengapa Sari sedikit kecewa saat lampu menyala lagi?

en: she had enjoyed the quiet time singing together
she was afraid of the light
she wanted to keep the torch
id: ia senang dengan waktu tenang bernyanyi bersama

connection.en: Our eyes need a few minutes to adjust to the dark; they still need a little light to see.
connection.id: Mata butuh beberapa menit untuk menyesuaikan diri dengan gelap; mata tetap butuh sedikit cahaya untuk melihat.

connection.en: Keeping a torch in a known place makes a power cut safer.
connection.id: Menyimpan senter di tempat yang diketahui membuat mati lampu lebih aman.

discussionPrompts.en: How did Sari feel at the start? How did she feel at the end?
discussionPrompts.id: Bagaimana perasaan Sari di awal? Bagaimana di akhir?

discussionPrompts.en: What sounds can you hear at night when the house is quiet?
discussionPrompts.id: Suara apa yang bisa kamu dengar di malam hari saat rumah sunyi?

offlineActivity.en: Choose one place at home for a 'lights-out' torch and show your child where it is. In the evening, turn off the lights for five minutes, sit together and list every sound you can hear.
offlineActivity.id: Pilih satu tempat di rumah untuk menyimpan senter 'mati lampu' dan tunjukkan kepada anak. Pada malam hari, matikan lampu selama lima menit, duduk bersama, dan sebutkan semua suara yang terdengar.

factChecks.claim: Human eyes take several minutes to adjust to the dark but cannot see in total darkness.

safetyNotes.en: Use a torch rather than candles during a power cut, and do not shine it into anyone's eyes.
safetyNotes.id: Pakai senter, bukan lilin, saat mati lampu, dan jangan menyorotkannya ke mata orang.
